title: Delay Complexity Dimension: Learning with Delayed and Censored Labels
abstract: arXiv:2610.18935v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study PAC learning of binary classifiers when labels arrive after random delays and are censored beyond an observation window $W$. How many samples does this observation model require? We propose a distribution-dependent answer, the Delay Complexity Dimension (DCD). The DCD combines the VC dimension with the exact label-information rate of the observation channel. Every learner needs $\Omega(\mathrm{DCD}/\varepsilon^2)$ samples. An oracle pseudo-label ERM matches this rate on the instance family of the lower bound, up to constants and logarithmic factors. On that family the DCD is within a constant factor of the classical censored-ERM complexity, and whether the DCD rate is achievable where the two separate remains open. The theory also yields a quantization scheme under which delay information lowers the residual label variance, an expedition policy with a $(1-1/e)$ guarantee for its version-space objective, and a phenomenon with n

translated_title: 延迟复杂度维度：带延迟与删失标签的学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究二元分类器的PAC学习问题，其中标签在随机延迟后到达，并在观测窗口 $W$ 之外被删失（截断）。这种观测模型需要多少样本？我们提出了一个依赖于分布的答案——延迟复杂度维度。DCD 将VC维度与观测信道的精确标签信息率相结合。任何学习器都需要 $\Omega(\mathrm{DCD}/\varepsilon^2)$ 个样本；在给出该下界的实例族上，一个预言机伪标签ERM（经验风险最小化）在常数和对数因子范围内达到这一速率。在该实例族上，DCD 与经典删失ERM复杂度相差一个常数因子；而在二者分离的情形下，DCD 速率是否可达到仍是开放问题。该理论还给出了一种量化方案，在该方案下延迟信息可降低残余标签方差；提出了一种在其版本空间目标上具有 $(1-1/e)$ 保证的探索策略；以及一个……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“延迟复杂度维度”（DCD），将VC维度与观测信道的标签信息率相结合，刻画了标签延迟且被删失情形下PAC学习的样本复杂度，证明任何学习器需要 Ω(DCD/ε²) 个样本，且伪标签ERM可在常数与对数因子内达到该界。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Delay Complexity Dimension (DCD), combining VC dimension with the observation channel's label-information rate to characterize the sample complexity of PAC learning with delayed and censored labels, proving every learner needs Ω(DCD/ε²) samples and that an oracle pseudo-label ERM matches this bound up to constants and logarithmic factors.
